houston.title: Houston
houston.lede: Top Appliances Repair is a Houston appliance repair company. We repair refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers, stoves, ovens, cooktops, microwaves, freezers, ice makers and garbage disposals for every major brand, including Sub-Zero. Our shop is in southwest Houston, we offer same-day visits across the city, and every job starts with a free estimate.

notes.p: Our shop is on South Kirkwood Road in the 77072 area, so technicians reach most of the city the same day. Inside the Loop, the Energy Corridor, the Medical Center area, Clear Lake and everything in between are all on our regular routes.

notes.h: Houston heat and humidity are hard on appliances
notes.p: Garage and patio refrigerators work against 100-degree ambient heat, which is why condenser cleaning matters so much here. Humidity shows up as mildew in front-load washer gaskets and as long dry times when a vent duct is partly blocked.

faqs.q: Do you offer same-day appliance repair in Houston?
faqs.a: Yes. Same-day service is our standard across Houston. Call or book online, tell us what the appliance is doing, and we schedule a technician for the same day whenever the slot is still open.

faqs.q: What parts of Houston do you cover?
faqs.a: We cover the city and the surrounding area, from inside the Loop out to the Energy Corridor, Memorial, the Heights, Bellaire and the suburbs along I-10, US-290, I-45 and US-59.

faqs.q: How much does a repair cost?
faqs.a: The technician diagnoses the appliance at your home and gives you a free estimate before any work starts. You see the price first and decide whether to go ahead.

faqs.q: Which brands do you repair in Houston?
faqs.a: All major brands, including Sub-Zero, Thermador, Viking, Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, GE, Bosch, KitchenAid, Maytag, Kenmore, Jenn-Air, Amana, Admiral and Thor.

faqs.q: Do you warranty the repair?
faqs.a: Yes. Every repair is covered by our 90-day warranty on the parts we install and the labor.

houston.meta_description: Appliance repair in Houston, TX: refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers and ovens. Same-day service, free estimate and a 90-day warranty.
